## Needs env var
`CAL_COM_API_KEY` must be set on the **n8n service** in Railway (not just in the dr-squeegee app).

Cal.com v2 uses a **different `cal-api-version` per resource**: event-types `2024-06-14`, slots `2024-09-04`, bookings `2024-08-13`. Do not unify them.

**2026-09-08:** this n8n blocks `$env` inside nodes, so Cal.com auth is the *Cal.com API Key (drsqclt)* Header Auth credential (id 6N8Gw12AStkWa9P3) and the Twilio account SID, messaging-service SID and owner number are constants in the nodes. No Railway env vars are read.
